definitions.U: Exact NPU compute overlap/(32*T); full fixed window denominator includes all stalls andidle.
definitions.slo: Requests admitted in the half-openwindow; complete processing latency completion-admission <= alpha*8*own per-layerC. Follow completions afterwindowend; not first-token measurement or arrival TTFT.
definitions.seed_statistics: Equal-weight seed means with sampleSD; pooled request pass ratio is separately retained. Partial groups never represented as finished five-seed statistics.
definitions.pair: Same seed andwholeinput manifest SHA andinputfingerprint verified. Cohorts may differ bystrategy because admission times differ.
definitions.populations: h65000 rebuilds/re-shuffles a newfullpopulation; it is not an extension sharing theh22000prefix. Their same2–4s windows neednotmatch.
definitions.physical: Native exactphysicalbin recorder ends20s; noSSDgrant/busybandwidth is inferred for20–60s.
definitions.scope: Only explicit canonical directories are accepted; no recursive scan into replays, failed attempts or imported runtime copies.

plan_details.selection: After observing the separately executed local seed7 Once improvement, run Once for all four previously fixed seeds19/43/67/101. Their Baseline outcomes already exist; retain every paired result without seed or coverage filtering. Do not duplicate seed7.

context384_once_confirmation.selection_stage: The Once confirmation was commissioned after the seed7 Once gain was observed; it was not preregistered at the beginning of the research.
context384_once_confirmation.seed_selection: 19/43/67/101 fixed before observing those Once outcomes; no substitutions or coverage-based exclusions.
context384_once_confirmation.reporting: Five-seed strategy means and pair means include discovery seed7; the four confirmation-only paired statistics are separately shown.
context384_once_confirmation.raw_once_scope: raw105 and raw110 each have Once only at seed7 (n=1), not five-seed Once confirmation.

hetero_short_confirmation.selection_stage: After the seed7 heterogeneous-short robustness run met the target and coverage conditions, run all four fixed additional Baseline seeds19/43/67/101 and a seed7 Once pair. Retain all outcomes.
hetero_short_confirmation.matched_control_scope: The proper homogeneous control is S12, with the same coarse L/S order and totalC/V. The original context384 S10 run has a different mix and mean short profile; it is not a single-variable heterogeneity comparison.

qualifications.context384: Long384K/m1024 andshort10K/m128 use explicitC extrapolation; idealrho.996878 is not instantaneous underload.
qualifications.raw110: Same rawprofiles,count17:31, idealrho1.100796; mildlyoverloaded sensitivity outside initial.95–1.05, notunderload evidence.
qualifications.hetero_short: 8SSU; L384K/m1024 and S10/12/14K/m128 in equal short fractions, count1:6:6:6, idealrho1.002029. All C values explicitly extrapolated. Baseline5 seeds; Once only seed7.
